targets.description: Issued occurrence ids (O#) or source aliases.

function.name: get_repeated_occurrences
function.description: Find other lines in the same document whose text repeats the target after a fixed normalization (case, dot leaders, trailing page number, digits masked). Useful for running headers/footers or contents entries vs. body headings.

target.description: An issued occurrence id such as O7, or a source alias such as L0012:S0 seen in supplied evidence.

function.name: compare_occurrences
function.description: Compare two source locations side by side, for example a contents entry and the body line it may refer to, or a title and the line below it: each with its context window, layout and page statistics, plus arithmetic deltas (page distance, same normalized text, font-size, bold and left-edge differences). Observations only.

first.description: An issued occurrence id such as O7, or a source alias such as L0012:S0 seen in supplied evidence.

second.description: An issued occurrence id such as O7, or a source alias such as L0012:S0 seen in supplied evidence.

window.description: Context lines before and after each location.
